## What changes, for whom

One paragraph in product words: what a user or an agent can do after this
that they could not before, or what stops going wrong.

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm test:oss-boundary` pass locally
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] I have agreed to the Contributor License Agreement (first contribution)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased when behaviour changes
- [ ] Documentation under `docs/` is updated when configuration or architecture changes
